_doc: Product-to-competitor benchmark mapping for ENH-134 ProductCompetitiveIntelligence. Maps each of our products in data/products.json to the appropriate competitor benchmark key in data/competitor_data.json (lending_rates / deposit_rates). Products without a clear competitor benchmark are listed in unmapped[] with rationale — operators can extend over time.
_notes: rate_avg field on each product in products.json is the OUR_BANK rate used in benchmarking
When a product is mapped to a competitor benchmark, rates are compared against peer set excluding our own bank
Salary Advance (P004) mapped to Personal Loan as closest analogue — operators may want a separate benchmark when one becomes available
Corporate Loans (P009) mapped to Business Loan as closest analogue; tier-1 corporate-specific pricing may differ materially
Fixed Deposits (P014) mapped to 12M Fixed by default; bank can change to 3M/6M for shorter-tenor products
